name: Bedroom Blitz
blurb: A toy racing set built round a real bedroom: off the desk, down a wide spiral round the lamp, under the bed, through the loop in the middle of the room, past the sneakers and back up over the dresser.

name: Kitchen Chaos
blurb: A toy racing set built round a real kitchen: along the worktop, over a bridge onto the kitchen table, down a wide spiral round a stool, through the loop by the back door, and a long climb home past the fridge.

name: Garage Overdrive
blurb: A toy racing set built round a real garage: off the line past the big door, up a plank onto the workbench, a flying leap off its end, down a spiral round a stack of tyres, the loop, and a chicane across the oil-stained floor.

name: Backyard Mega Circuit
blurb: A toy racing set laid right round the back garden: along the patio under the windows, through the goal, a spiral up the tree and a long drop, down a drainpipe, behind the shed and home under the washing line. One lap is as long as three of the others.

name: Prep Table Showdown
blurb: Balloon Battle on a pizzeria prep table: an open middle to line up a shot, a pizza-box lid for a ramp onto the stacked boxes, and a row of ingredient bins to dodge round.
